latin: Si Thommas dixerit in intelligentiis secundum Aristotelem esse accidentia, non Aristoteli modo, sed sibiipsi contradicet.
translation: If Thomas should say that, according to Aristotle, accidents exist in the intelligences, he will contradict not only Aristotle but himself as well.
